findings.title: orders table has no Row Level Security
findings.attacker: Anyone with the anon key, which ships in the Flutter app. No account needed.
trace: supabase/migrations/20240101000000_init.sql:12 creates public.orders (user_id, total, address); no migration enables RLS
Live check: pg_class.relrowsecurity = false for public.orders (query from checks/TABLES.md, run by the developer)
GET /rest/v1/orders?select=* with the anon key returns every customer's address; DELETE is also allowed
findings.impact: Disclosure of every customer's delivery address and order history, and the ability to change or delete any order.
findings.fix: New migration: alter table public.orders enable row level security; create policy "Read own orders" on public.orders for select to authenticated using ((select auth.uid()) = user_id); create policy "Create own orders" on public.orders for insert to authenticated with check ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);
findings.verified_by: verifier-2 (fresh pass over all migrations and the live pg_class result)
